items.title: Jefferies Names this Construction Software Maker Top Pick in Vertical Software

items.title: What Is Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) Signaling With Its New Alzheimer’s Trial And Tests?
items.summary: Genentech and Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) shared new Alzheimer's data across medicines and diagnostics at the 19th CTAD Congress in 2026. The group initiated a Phase II study of an oral NLRP3 inhibitor aimed at reducing neuroinflammation in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease. Roche also reported progress on blood-based biomarker assays designed to support earlier and less invasive Alzheimer's diagnosis.
